registered_before: any V0.4 control, weather, land-cover, geology or model result was computed or viewed

baseline.name: PreSlide V0.3 Baseline
baseline.rule: read only; V0.4 writes only data/v04/, models/v04/, reports/v04/

inclusion.source: GeoSphere Austria Naturgefahren (Test), local snapshot data/raw/geosphere_natural_hazards.json
inclusion.coordinates: Austrian bounding box at audit, GISCO Austria polygon at matching
inclusion.deduplication: identical coordinate and event day kept once
inclusion.quality_tier: tier 1 = the V0 quality fields above. Media records with QUAL_PROZ/QUAL_MB = 'keine Information' are tier 2: counted, never mixed into the main analysis.

dates.primary_tier: A_narrative_day: exactly one explicit narrative day equal to the structured day, structured interval (Date_Anfan..Date_End_a) inside that local day, no uncertainty wording
dates.excluded: uncertain wording, conflicting or multiple days, month-level text, interval not within one day

time_quality.day: t0 = 00:00 local of the event day
time_quality.daypart: t0 = earliest stated daypart start: Vormittag 06, Mittag 11, Nachmittag 12, Abend 17, Frueh/Morgen 00; a daypart preceded by 'spaetestens'/'vor'/'bis' is an upper bound and ignored; 'Nacht' on a single day allows only explicit clock bounds
time_quality.clock: t0 = earliest stated event clock time minus 1 h, floored to the hour; upper bounds ('vor', 'bis', 'spaetestens') and times attached to alarm/observation/weather words are never used
time_quality.always: t0 = max(local midnight, min(text bound, provider structured start floored to the hour))

episodes.temporal_episode: single linkage over local event days with gap <= 3 days, all Austria (V0 rule)
episodes.spatiotemporal_unit: within a temporal episode, single linkage of positives at <= 50 km (geodesic, EPSG:31287 metres)
episodes.dependence_check: for every pair of spatio-temporal units inside the same temporal episode: Pearson correlation of 6-hourly INCA RR sums (unit mean over its positives) over the 14 days before the earlier unit t0 (56 values). Spatio-temporal units are accepted only if the 90th percentile of these correlations is < 0.5; otherwise temporal episodes are used everywhere. Uses weather inputs only, never labels or scores; run after the INCA download and before any model.
episodes.location_links: positives < 2 km apart on any dates, and any two samples of different groups < 400 m apart, are always in the same unit (V0 rule)
episodes.independence_unit: accepted unit (spatio-temporal or temporal) union location links; used for CV folds, training weights, evaluation weights and bootstrap

partition.block: independence unit computed on the candidate positives (location links of samples added after matching)
partition.development: every block containing at least one V0.3 baseline candidate (102 events): these storms were already used or seen
partition.sealed_test: every block without a baseline candidate. Rationale (decided from partition sizes only, before any matching, weather or model output): with temporal episodes only 13 of 35 blocks are baseline-free, and a 1/3 hash rule would leave about 6 test events; an independent external test is the stated top priority
partition.spatial_purge: after matching, a test group with any sample < 1 km from a development sample is moved to development
partition.frozen_file: data/v04/partition/partition.json with sha256, written before any model is fit
partition.test_scored: exactly once, after all models, features and code are frozen (reports/v04/FREEZE.json)
partition.old_test_note: V0 test and Steiermark holdout events are already seen. They sit in development; no V0.4 choice is made from results (everything here is fixed in advance).

matching.same_t0: controls inherit t0 of their positive

static_terrain.source: Mapzen/AWS Skadi 1 arc-second composite, object Last-Modified must precede t0 (unchanged V0 rule)
static_terrain.hydrology_rule: Planchon-Darboux depression filling and D8 accumulation on a 30 m window of radius control_max + 5 km; a sample whose upslope area reaches the window edge is MISSING (truncated catchment), never imputed
static_terrain.rejected: DGM Oesterreich 10 m (gis.ktn.gv.at ogd-10m-at.zip, 1.94 GB, object Last-Modified 2019-06-18, no per-cell acquisition date): postdates most events, so not demonstrably pre-event

land_cover.source: Copernicus CORINE Land Cover vector via EEA discomap ArcGIS MapServer
land_cover.vintage_rule: CLC2018 (imagery 2017-2018) only if t0 >= 2019-01-01, else CLC2012 (imagery 2011-2012)

geology.leakage_check: no mass-movement deposit classes in representativeLithology

temporal_inca.timestamp_rule: an hourly value at timestamp T is used only if T + 1 h < t0 and T - 1 h >= window start (interval may end or start at T)
temporal_inca.same_day_rule: only if time_quality is daypart or clock; otherwise MISSING (not zero). Hours between local midnight and t0 under the timestamp rule; window with no complete hour is MISSING
temporal_inca.completeness: every expected hour of the 60-day window finite; RR in [0, 500], T2M in [-60, 60]; otherwise the event group is excluded (V0 rule)

spartacus-v2-1d-1km.day_end: RR of day D ends D+1 07:00 CET (06:00 UTC)

snowgrid_cl-v2-1d-1km.day_end: treated as valid at D+1 06:00 UTC (conservative; exact output time not documented)

winfore-v2-1d-1km.day_end: treated like RR, valid at D+1 06:00 UTC

temporal_daily.rule: use day D only if its end is strictly before t0; windows end at the last such day
temporal_daily.admission: each product enters the main run only after a 1 -> 5 -> 20 event pilot shows correct boundaries (tests), plausible values and >= 95% coverage

features.missing_values: never replaced by invented values. Linear models: a feature missing for any sample of a group gives that group no within-group contrast for it (set to the training mean for all six samples); HistGradientBoosting uses native missing handling. Coverage is reported per feature.

conditional_logit.implementation: own scipy L-BFGS stratified likelihood (no new dependency)

models.training_weights: each event group weighted 1/sqrt(events of its independence unit in the training data)
models.no_tuning: no hyperparameter search, no seed search, no feature selection

evaluation.primary_endpoint: sealed test, conditional logit, combined: independence-unit-weighted mean within-group AUC (rank of the positive among its 5 controls)
evaluation.primary_comparison: combined minus static, same model and test groups; 95% unit-bootstrap interval (2000 draws)

chance.null: random ranks within each group, same unit weights, 10000 draws

evaluation.development_cv: 5 folds x 5 repetitions (seeds 11, 23, 37, 51, 71) over independence units; preprocessing fit on each training fold only
evaluation.development_null: conditional logit, 100 within-group label permutations on repetition 1 folds
evaluation.spatial_check: development leave-one-state-out (states with >= 3 units), conditional logit; descriptive only
